title: Supplies, Courier and Client Service Rules for Physician Client Accounts
content:
Collection supplies and courier service for Physician Client Accounts are provided only while the account status is active.

## Rule A: account status

Supplies and courier service are only provided while the account status is active, as the account record shows it.

| Account status on record | Supplies and courier service |
|---|---|
| Active | Provided |
| Pending setup | Not provided |
| Credit hold | Not provided |
| Closed | Not provided |

## Rule B: collection supplies

- Supplies are provided free of charge only for collecting and shipping specimens to the laboratory; items outside the class's list of supply items, or for any other use, are never shipped.
- Supply orders must be at least the class's number of calendar days apart, and an order carries at most the class's maximum number of supply items.
- Each supply order is recorded by item, quantity and order date.

## Rule C: courier pickups

- The account receives the class's number of scheduled pickups each business day, in the class's pickup windows, with the class's latest pickup time for same-day processing.
- Up to the class's number of extra pickups may be added in a month. The count is the number of added pickups on the account in the calendar month of the requested pickup date.
- STAT pickups are available only where the class offers them.
- Each extra or STAT pickup is recorded on the account as an added pickup, with its date and pickup window.

## Rule D: phlebotomy, results and occupational services

- A phlebotomist is placed in the office only where the class offers placement and the office averages at least the class's figure for daily draws; the placed phlebotomist performs only laboratory specimen collection.
- Results reach the organization by the class's result delivery methods, and critical results are phoned within the class's number of minutes.
- Occupational panels, chain-of-custody collection and MRO review are offered only where the class offers each of them.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates and figures)

- **Supply spacing**, with 7 days as the example figure: after a supply order on the 3rd of a month, an order on the 10th is 7 calendar days later and meets the spacing; an order on the 9th, 6 days later, does not.
- **Items per order**, with 8 as the example figure: an order of 8 supply items is within the limit; an order of 9 is over it.
- **Extra pickups**, with 4 as the example figure: an account that already has 4 added pickups in May cannot add a fifth for a date in May; a pickup requested for 2 June counts toward June, whatever day the request is made.
- **Item list**: an item that is not on the class's list of supply items is never shipped, whatever the quantity.
